# Dynatrace to Report Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results


October 20, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_b627985dbd3bd12c66f083572875546a/dynatrace/news/2026-10-20_Dynatrace_to_Report_Second_Quarter_Fiscal_Year_441.pdf)


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Dynatrace](https://www.dynatrace.com/) (NYSE: DT), the leading AI-powered observability platform, today announced that it will report financial results for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027 ended September 30, 2026 before the U.S. financial markets open on November 3, 2026. In conjunction with this report, Dynatrace will host a conference call and live webcast to discuss the company’s financial results and its business outlook.


**Conference Call Details** The conference call will begin at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time on November 3, 2026. To access the conference call from the U.S. and Canada, dial (866) 405-1247, or internationally, dial (201) 689-8045 with conference ID # 13763418. The call will also be available live via webcast on the company’s website,[ir.dynatrace.com](https://ir.dynatrace.com/) .


An audio replay of the call will be available until 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 17, 2026, by dialing (877) 660-6853 from the U.S. or Canada, or for international callers by dialing (201) 612-7415 and entering conference ID # 13763418. In addition, an archived webcast will be available at[ir.dynatrace.com](https://ir.dynatrace.com/) .


**About Dynatrace**[Dynatrace](https://nam02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dynatrace.com%2F&data=04%7C01%7Cjerome.stewart%40dynatrace.com%7Ca4a158c71295484b681d08da0b84ebea%7C70ebe3a35b30435d9d677716d74ca190%7C1%7C0%7C637834962762133510%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000&sdata=bWhFtm444RvhD9rgr0DEqj6zVPfQ4obQETw1taJ1eBk%3D&reserved=0) (NYSE: DT) is advancing observability for today’s digital businesses, helping to transform the complexity of modern digital ecosystems into powerful business assets. By leveraging AI-powered insights, Dynatrace enables organizations to analyze, automate, and innovate faster to drive their business forward.
